landing.heroTitle: AI ad performance reports for marketing agencies
landing.heroBody: Connect a client's ad accounts once. Repolio pulls the numbers every day, writes the report on the cadence you set, and holds it for review before your client ever sees it.
landing.stepsBody: Four stages. Once the accounts are connected, they run on their own.
landing.step1Body: Link a client's ad accounts through the platform's own OAuth flow. Repolio stores a reference, never a platform password.
landing.step2Body: One snapshot per ad account per complete day, every day. Nothing is overwritten, so any period can still be reported on later.
landing.step3Body: On the cadence you choose, the figures and a written narrative are produced together for the period being reported.
landing.step4Body: Finished reports collect in a batch for an admin to read. Releasing the batch is what sends the client their email.
landing.feature1Body: Only the raw daily rows and the narrative are stored. Every metric, comparison and score is recalculated on request, so nothing on screen can be out of date.
landing.feature2Body: Author the deliverable as HTML with placeholders for the figures. One template drives the page your client opens, their email and the attached PDF.
landing.feature3Body: A report stays invisible to its client until an admin releases it. Silence is never the thing that delivers a report.
landing.closingBody: Your agency enrolls you and sends the invitation. Sign in to read your reports.
